meta.title: Neighborhood Eats
meta.description: Pre-order food from local merchants and pick it up nearby.

login.title: Welcome
login.subtitle: Sign in to order food from local merchants.

home.title: Open for ordering
home.empty: Nothing is open for ordering right now.

offering.pickupOptionsHelp: Pick the slot that suits you; the foods and limits are the same.

orderForm.chooseOneOrCancel: Choose at least one item, or cancel the order instead.
orderForm.noteHelp: Mention allergies or special requests. Only you and the merchant can see this.
orderForm.notePlaceholder: e.g. No nuts please — severe allergy

order.showQr: Show this code to the merchant at pickup
order.canChangeUntil: You can change this order until {time}.
order.changeSlotHelp: Move this order to another pickup slot before the cutoff.

map.sharing: Merchant is sharing their live location.
map.notSharing: The merchant isn't sharing their location right now.

setup.title: Become a merchant
setup.intro: Create your merchant profile to start listing food for pickup.
setup.name: Business name
setup.countryInvalid: Use a 2-letter country code, e.g. US

profile.title: Merchant profile
profile.logoHelp: Shown to customers next to your name. It is resized, and any location data inside the picture is removed.
profile.logoUnsupported: This picture couldn't be read. Try a JPEG or PNG.
profile.contactHelp: Website, contact email and phone are shown to signed-in customers on your page. Leave them blank to keep them private.
profile.websiteInvalid: Enter a valid website address, e.g. https://example.com
profile.phoneInvalid: Enter a valid phone number (digits, spaces and + ( ) - . only).

translations.title: Translations (optional)
translations.help: Customers see their own language when you provide it, otherwise the original text above. Leave blank to skip.
translations.name: Name

dashboard.stats: {orders, plural, one {# order} other {# orders}} · {picked} picked up · {status}

pickupPoints.title: Pickup points
pickupPoints.name: Name
pickupPoints.timezoneUnknown: Unknown timezone (use an IANA name such as America/New_York)
pickupPoints.mapHint: Click the map (or drag the pin) to set the pickup spot, or type the coordinates.
pickupPoints.locationFailed: Couldn't get your location. Allow location access or click the map instead.
pickupPoints.searchPlaceholder: Business, place or address (e.g. 99 Ranch Market)
pickupPoints.noResults: No places found. Try another name or ZIP code, or click the map.
pickupPoints.searchUnavailable: Place search isn't available right now. Click the map or type the address instead.
pickupPoints.searchBusy: Too many searches. Please wait a minute.
pickupPoints.technicalHelp: Filled in for you when you pick a place or click the map. You rarely need to change these.
pickupPoints.timezoneAuto: Worked out from the map position
pickupPoints.locationMissing: Choose the place first: search for it, click the map, or use your current location.

foods.title: Foods
foods.name: Name
foods.photoHelp: It is resized, and any location data inside the picture is removed.
foods.photoUnsupported: This picture couldn't be read. Try a JPEG or PNG.

offerings.title: Offerings
offerings.needFirst: You need at least one <points>pickup point</points> and one <foods>food</foods> first.
offerings.foodsOnSale: Foods on sale (optional limit per item)
offerings.selectFood: Select at least one food item
offerings.lockedHint: This offering already has orders, so the pickup point and date can't be changed. You can still adjust the times, cutoff and foods.
offerings.pastHint: This pickup date has passed, so the schedule can't be edited.
offerings.instructionsHelp: Tell customers where and how to find you, e.g. "North gate, look for the red tent".
offerings.instructionsTooLong: Pickup instructions are too long (500 characters at most).
offerings.endAfterStart: The pickup end time must be after the start time.
offerings.extraSlotsHelp: Offer the same foods at other places or times on the same date. All slots share the date, cutoff, foods and limits; customers choose one.

review.title: Review your offering
review.intro: Customers will see this as soon as you publish. Check the details.
review.sharedLimits: Limits are shared across all pickup slots.
review.duplicateTitle: Same pickup point used more than once
review.duplicateBody: “{point}” is used for more than one pickup time on this day (for example morning and evening). Customers will see each time separately. Make sure this is what you want.

offeringDetail.duplicateHelp: Creates a draft with the same pickup point, times and foods. Review it and publish when ready.
offeringDetail.deleteConfirm: Delete this offering? This can't be undone.
offeringDetail.deleteBlocked: Offerings with orders can't be deleted. Close ordering instead.
offeringDetail.slotsHelp: These slots share the cutoff, foods and limits. Each has its own orders, prep list and live location.

location.onlyPickupDay: Live location can be turned on during the pickup date.
location.hint: Only customers with an order for this pickup can see it. Keep this page open while sharing.
location.notSupported: Geolocation isn't supported on this device.
location.banner: You are sharing your live location with customers who have an order.
location.privacyNote: Sharing stops when you tap Stop, leave this page or close it, and by itself after 4 hours. Customers stop seeing it within 2 minutes if updates stop.
location.autoStopped: Sharing was switched off automatically after 4 hours.
location.denied: Location access is blocked for this site. Allow it in your browser's site settings (the lock or settings icon next to the address), and make sure Location Services is on for your browser in your device settings. Then reload this page and try again.
location.unavailable: Your device couldn't determine its location. Check that Location Services is on and you have a signal, then try again.
location.timeout: Finding your location took too long. Check your signal and try again.

scan.title: Confirm pickup
scan.instructions: Scan the QR code on the customer's order.

customers.title: Customers
customers.line: {orders, plural, one {# order} other {# orders}} · {picked} picked up

reports.title: Most ordered foods
reports.weatherNote: Weather and holiday data is added automatically for each pickup date; very recent or future offerings may show as unknown.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.alreadyOrdered: You already have an order for this offering; edit it instead.
errors.noStock: Not enough stock remaining for one of the items.
errors.cannotChange: This order can no longer be changed.
errors.emptyOrder: An order must contain at least one item.
errors.itemNotInOffering: An item doesn't belong to this offering.
errors.otherMerchant: This order belongs to a different merchant.
errors.cutoffAfterPickup: The cutoff must be before the pickup start time.
errors.merchantHasActiveOrders: You still have upcoming orders from customers. Cancel or complete them before deleting your account.
errors.pastOfferingLocked: This pickup date has passed, so its schedule can no longer be edited.
errors.offeringHasOrdersLocked: This offering already has orders, so its pickup point and date can't be changed.
errors.offeringHasOrders: This offering has orders and can't be deleted. Close ordering instead.
errors.itemHasOrders: A food that customers have already ordered can't be removed from this offering.
errors.limitBelowOrdered: An item's limit can't be lower than the quantity already ordered.
errors.newDatePast: Choose a date that is today or later.
errors.emptyOffering: An offering must include at least one food.
errors.imageType: Please choose a JPEG or PNG photo.
errors.imageTooLarge: That photo is too large. Try a smaller one.
errors.imageInvalid: That file isn't a valid photo.
errors.imageUploadFailed: The food was saved, but the photo couldn't be uploaded. Please try again.
errors.noteTooLong: The note is too long (300 characters at most).
errors.slotsSameDate: All pickup slots must be on the same date.
errors.pickupPointHasOrders: This pickup point has upcoming orders, so its address and map position can't be moved. You can rename it, or add a new pickup point.

account.title: Account
account.dangerIntro: Deleting your account is permanent and cannot be undone. This will remove:
account.deletesMerchant: if you are a merchant: your foods and their photos, pickup points and offerings, and all orders on them (your customers lose that order history)
account.blocked: You can't delete your account yet: customers have upcoming orders with you. Cancel or complete those orders first.
account.confirmMismatch: Please type DELETE exactly to confirm.
account.emailIntro: Order confirmations, pickup reminders and (for merchants) order summaries.

legal.contactFallback: the contact address provided by the operator of this site
legal.agree: By continuing you agree to our <terms>Terms of Service</terms> and <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.

pickupReminder.button: Open your order and QR code
